name: Powder Pace
description: Plants the feet a shoulder apart, turns the lock side toward the mark and seats the butt in the hollow of the shoulder.

name: Leaden Barrelband
description: Levels the barrel on the mark, holds the breath and squeezes so the ball leaves in one flat line.

name: Firm Aim
description: Drives the iron butt-plate forward into the opponent's ribs, stepping through the blow to shorten the gap.

name: Resting Stockbutt
description: Sweeps the barrel across the body to knock a cut or thrust aside, then returns it to the shoulder.

name: Salvohop
description: Backs two paces behind the line and drops to a knee with the muzzle up, so the hands can begin the load.

name: Gentle Ramrod
description: Bites the paper cartridge open and primes the pan from it before snapping the frizzen shut.

name: Pancount
description: Judges a powder charge by the weight of the measure against the thumb, so the load is neither short nor heavy.

name: Steady Bayonetlug
description: Drives ball and patch home in one full stroke of the ramrod, then slides the rod back into its pipes.

name: Serpent Dodge
description: Loads while advancing at a slow march, holding the muzzle raised and the stride even over rough ground.

name: Quiet Smoke
description: Rolls from the prone onto one side so both hands can load while the ground hides the body.

name: Salvodrop
description: Brings the freshly loaded musket to the shoulder and fires on the first sight picture without settling.

name: Sideways Load
description: Sets the rear heel and bends the front knee, so the kick of the piece runs down the legs and not the back.

name: Touchpan Note
description: Presses the cheek to the stock and lines the eye along the barrel, giving a sight picture that repeats.

name: Sudden Lockplate
description: Squeezes the trigger over three heartbeats so the shot breaks without any jerk of the barrel.

name: Even Wheellock
description: Rolls the shoulder back with the kick of the butt and brings the aim up again before the smoke clears.

name: Firm Prime
description: Lays the barrel in the crook of a fork or post, taking the weight off the arms for a long careful aim.

name: Narrow Pan
description: Drops to the right knee with the left elbow braced on the left knee and fires low beneath the rank ahead.

name: Light Wheellock
description: Swings the musket from the hip carry up to the shoulder in one motion while stepping into the stance.

name: Fuzenote
description: Slides the bayonet socket over the muzzle and twists it home along its slot without taking the eyes off the opponent.

name: Gnawing Lockplate
description: Lunges with the rear leg driving and both hands pushing the bayonet point into the opponent's chest.

name: Gnawing Smoke
description: Tucks the butt against the hip and jabs the point upward beneath the opponent's guard.

name: Settled Stockbutt
description: Beats the opponent's point inward with the barrel, clearing the line for a thrust of one's own.

name: Ramrodstay
description: Sweeps an incoming thrust outward in a flat arc of the barrel and steps off the line of attack.

name: Sharp Flintcock
description: Swings the butt up from below the hip into the opponent's jaw as the bayonet end drops clear.

name: Panwedge
description: Holds the musket crosswise at chest height in both hands so barrel and stock take a descending blow.

name: Quiet Bayonetlug
description: Backs away from a lunge in three short paces with the bayonet point held steady on the opponent's throat.

name: Stepping Flintcock
description: Carries the musket at the trail on its sling and keeps a long, even march step over distance.

name: Smooth Barrelband
description: Clears the touchhole with the wire pricker and primes the pan again after a misfire in damp air.

name: Kept Pan
description: Cups a palm and sleeve over the pan and lock to keep rain and spray from wetting the priming.

name: Ramrodreview
description: Scrapes powder fouling from the pan and frizzen with a thumb-piece so the flint keeps striking true.

name: Fuzegauge
description: Feels the lock, flint and ramrod by touch while the eyes stay on the road ahead.

name: Kind Touchpan
description: Threads a trace of qi into the thumb to snap the frizzen shut and set the prime in one motion.

name: Narrow Salvo
description: Lets a thread of qi settle the forearms as the barrel comes level, then fires on the exhale.

name: Tending Barrelband
description: Warms the hands with circulating qi so the ramrod stroke stays smooth and quick in cold weather.

name: Skipping Ramrod
description: Steps a pace toward the lock side while reloading, a flicker of qi in the legs keeping the balance.

name: Smokehit
description: Drives the butt forward with qi gathered in the shoulder, landing harder than plain arm strength allows.

name: Solid Pan
description: Flicks the muzzle up and across to turn a thrust away, qi tightening the wrists at the touch.

name: Aimpace
description: Shuffles sideways to close the gap with the next man in rank, qi keeping the stance steady.

name: Leaden Salvo
description: Fires on the drum with the whole rank at once, laying a flat sheet of shot across the front.

name: Gentle Touchpan
description: Passes a loaded musket forward and takes back the empty one, qi quickening the handoff so the line never gaps.

name: Low Aim
description: Kneels and fires beneath the second rank's shots, qi bracing the knee against the recoil.

name: Ramrodhusk
description: Locks shoulders with the men on both sides so a charging blow strikes the line as one body.

name: Fuzecount
description: Counts the drumbeats with the breath so that loading and firing keep step with the rank.

name: Snug Serpent
description: Holds the fixed bayonet level at the waist and beats aside any point probing the line.

name: Even Bayonetlug
description: Draws a half breath and pauses it at the bottom of the exhale while sighting along the barrel.

name: Wheellock Gauge
description: Lays the front blade on the mark and keeps the eye fixed there, ignoring the target's small movements.

name: Stiff Load
description: Lifts the aim a hand's width above the mark to meet a longer range and trusts the ball's drop.

name: Fuzeblow
description: Swings the barrel ahead of a walking target and fires as it crosses the line of the bore.

name: Stockbutt Count
description: Presses the left elbow to the ribs and sends qi down the arm to lock the hold for the length of the aim.

name: Deep Lockplate
description: Rehearses the pull on an empty pan with qi quieting the finger, learning where the lock breaks.

name: Quick Ramrod
description: Holds the aim through several heartbeats on a sustained breath, then lets the shot go in the pause.

name: Wide Aim
description: Fires on the rise from the hip at a target a few paces away, without time for a full sight picture.

name: Flintcock Count
description: Breathes in on four counts and out on four, steadying heart and barrel before the shot.

name: Primedash
description: Lets the trigger break at the end of a slow exhale, when the barrel is stillest.

name: Deep Flintcock
description: Drops the barrel onto the mark in the pause after the breath and lets qi hold it there.

name: Ramrodnote
description: Reloads with slow breaths through the nose, keeping the heart from racing between shots.

name: Pandrop
description: Feels the pulse in the fingertip and fires in the gap between two beats, when the barrel does not shiver.

name: Powderhop
description: Takes a quick step back on a short sharp breath to clear a lunge while the barrel stays level.

name: Locking Powder
description: Levels the musket at an approaching stranger and holds there, a steady muzzle forcing the person to halt.

name: Folded Pan
description: Drops to a knee behind a post or stone and keeps the barrel resting on the cover.

name: Stepping Serpent
description: Walks a pace off the shoulder of a person under escort, keeping the musket between them and the road.

name: Loadlid
description: Crosses two bayonets in front of a rushing intruder so the point stops the charge before the body does.

name: Powder Blow
description: Fires high over a crowd so the crack alone makes the front ranks drop and give ground.

name: Hooding Bayonetlug
description: Shades the pan with the hat brim and a cupped hand so no spark or flash gives away the post.

name: Fuzedrop
description: Raps the stock down across an opponent's wrist to make the hand open and let go of a weapon.

name: Ramrod Count
description: Counts each step of the load aloud under the breath so it can be done with the eyes shut against smoke.

name: Serpent Gauge
description: Reads the orders of the file leader from his raised hand when the din is too loud for the voice.

name: Salvostrike
description: Fires along the last clear sight line into the haze, trusting the barrel's bearing instead of the mark.

name: Quiet Load
description: Steps back into the drifting cloud after firing so the next volley's smoke covers the retreat.

name: Pangauge
description: Holds a shallow even breath through the sulphur haze so coughing never spoils the aim.
